graph_team_stat_cfb_replacement_def_epa_.description: CFB: the graph team_stat column as a REPLACEMENT input rather than an addition, cell def_epa_per_play. Candidate = the frozen XLG-03 CFB benchmark contract (CFB_MODEL_FEATURE_COLUMNS, 35 columns, ridge alpha 10, 500-game training floor, weekly refit) with home_def_epa_per_play + away_def_epa_per_play + diff_def_epa_per_play REMOVED and the signed-Katz differential of def_epa_per_play propagated over the CFB schedule graph appended (33 columns). Reference = the unmodified benchmark. All three raw columns go together because CFB_TEAM_STATE_FEATURES generates them as one triple per metric and diff equals home minus away exactly (measured, max abs residual 0.0 on 12431 rows), so a diff-only swap would be reconstructable by a linear ridge and would test nothing. Graded at the benchmark own spread_line, XLG-03 clean core 2012-2019+2021-2025, 199 weeks. This is a DIFFERENT comparator from the graph_team_stat_cfb_replication family, which measured ADDITION on top of a contract that still carried the raw statistic. Benchmark accuracy 51.5952 pct, candidate 51.3377 pct.
graph_team_stat_cfb_replacement_def_epa_.notes: PRIMARY (replacement minus benchmark), close grade, n=8933: -0.2575 pts, week 95% [-0.6844,+0.2326], week P+ 0.145, season P+ 0.179; observed at the 8.0th percentile of its own 200-draw within-week permutation null (null mean +0.034, sd 0.213). OPENER secondary (spread_open, n=8925): -0.0224 pts, week 95% [-0.4781,+0.4714], P+ 0.462; benchmark opener accuracy 51.7199 pct. Picks moved: 450 of 9093 close (4.95 pct), 455 of 9076 opener. SECONDARY A, ablation minus benchmark (what the raw triple is worth at all): -0.0672 pts close P+ 0.396, +0.0896 pts opener P+ 0.662, 387 picks moved. SECONDARY B, replacement minus ablation (the graph column in the vacated slot, the cleanest graph-as-representation read): -0.1903 pts close P+ 0.064 season P+ 0.046, -0.1120 pts opener P+ 0.175, 171 picks moved (1.88 pct). Era magnitudes (report only, close, primary): 2012-2019 +0.000 pts P+ 0.485 95% [-0.563,+0.582] n=5349; 2021-2025 -0.642 pts P+ 0.040 95% [-1.408,+0.112] n=3584 -- the larger recent-era magnitude still reaches above zero and closes nothing. Instrument checks passed before the screen. Reliability measured this session: graph trait Spearman-Brown +0.9929 vs raw +0.9775, both P+ 1.000; NOTE both quantities are heavily autocorrelated within a season (lagged EWM and cumulative propagated state), so odd/even-week split-half here is closer to a stability measure than to a per-game reliability and should not be compared with event-like traits elsewhere in the registry. CFB is replication evidence and changes no NFL card. Sibling WP8 add-on reading on the same window and grade for contrast: -0.011 pts P+ 0.467 moving 1.92 pct of picks.
graph_team_stat_cfb_replacement_def_epa_.plain_summary: On college football, swapping a defence efficiency stat out of the model and putting its schedule-graph version in its place made the picks slightly worse at the closing line and essentially unchanged at the opener. It moved about 5 percent of the picks. Too small to call either way.
